summary: Deep-audit-reconciled doc-impact matrix for later explicit compile of native PM-owned fff-inspired discovery. This matrix is source-lineage only and does not write canonical Plans.

Do not update Plans/.plan_index, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions from this matrix pass.
Do not treat direct fff or OpenCode implementation details as PM product authority.
Do not create a second regex/content-search canon beside Instant Grep / grep / codesearch.
Do not revive Chain Wizard, Plan Wizard, Requirements Doc Builder, or Start Chain as current product terms.

compile_obligations: Apply FileSafe, Permissions_System, ignore rules, secret exclusions, worktree/project boundaries, symlink policy, root/home scan guardrails, and no-leak rules before and during indexing/querying.

compile_obligations: Assistant Chat threads show discovery activity by default.

Provide the exact GUI setting Settings > Assistant Chat > Activity > `Show file discovery activity in chat`, default on.
Use setting description copy: `Show when assistants look for candidate files, use stale or fallback indexes, select files, and verify them.`
The setting controls presentation only: it must not hide permission prompts, safety messages, durable receipts, final relevant summaries, exact-verification linkage, or auditability.

State that the Assistant Chat setting controls routine discovery progress only; permission prompts, approval cards, safety messages, trust-affecting fallback/stale disclosures, durable receipts, and exact-verification linkage are never suppressible.

Backlink to UI_Command_Catalog if the setting or thread action becomes a typed UICommand.
